content:
I would say Mouchette is playable at e0/e1 but there are better characters at lower investment. E3 is where she really shines as well as having her wheel. She is the best dps in the game if you manage to get her here.

Meanwhile, if you have less resources ghelot is a perfectly serviceable dps with helot Thais and aigis and will get you to lategame easily
thread_title: 13-day player looking for advice on pulls & progression

content: What sort of score are you aiming for? I would suggest building a team around these 4 if you are looking at 300-350. Gmurphy, Glotan, Ghelot, Pollux + Whale carry mouchette
